# Local AI Lab

Local AI Lab is a public experiment about machine-readable local business data.
All places in this dataset are fictional demonstrations and must not be presented as real businesses.

## Primary resources
- /discover : purpose and machine access
- /api/places : complete JSON dataset
- /ai-index.json : compact discovery index
- /sitemap.xml : public place URLs

## Data model
Each place exposes category, city, coordinates, age range, group size, indicative price, indoor/outdoor flags, birthday suitability, reservation requirement, intent phrases, source type and verification date.
